Subject: Pilot runway — can we add 2 weeks and what would that cost?

Hi Hannah,

Quick one from our side — engineering is still validating the integration and we need an extra two weeks on the pilot to finish the throughput tests (we hit a larger-than-expected dataset).

A few specifics:
- Current pilot ends 2026-09-18. We want to extend to 2026-10-02.
- We’ve consumed ~78% of the allocated token bucket; projected burn will be ~125% by the new end date.
- Would Redwood consider a short extension with a reduced charge on the incremental usage (either a % discount on overage token rates or a small one-time amendment fee)?

If possible, we’d prefer a simple approach so procurement can sign quickly. Happy to accept an invoice for the extension or a DocuSign amendment.

Thanks — Alex

Thanks for the note, Alex — glad the integration is getting traction. Short answer: yes, we can do an extension.

Two practical options that keep things simple for procurement:

Option A — Time extension + discounted overage
- Extend the pilot to 2026-10-02 (2 extra weeks).
- Additional usage during the extension billed at your current pilot rate with a 20% discount applied to any incremental tokens above the original allocation.
- No change to SLA or support hours.

Option B — Convert remaining allocation to a surge credit + flat extension
- Keep the original end date in the contract, but issue a one-time surge credit equal to 10% of your original pilot token allocation (applied to post-pilot usage).
- If you still need the extra time, we’ll provide the two-week extension free of charge but incremental usage will be billed at the standard lookout rate (no discount).

We recommend Option A if you expect >110% burn during the extension (predictable discount is easier for procurement). Option B is cleaner if you want to avoid amending dates.

I’ve looped in Connor for the operational side (capacity/slots) and Marissa for pricing/legal, they can confirm feasibility. If you want, I can draft a two-line amendment and send it via DocuSign for signature tomorrow.

Best,
Hannah
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
